_comment: DEMO fixture tasks for the Tarkado full loop. Instructions are fixed demo text, not private developer prompts. Runtime outputs stay under local/full-loop/ (gitignored).

instructions.documentation: In this repository, add concise, accurate docstrings to {target}: a module docstring as the very first statement of the file, and a docstring for every public function, class and method in it. Only add docstrings: do not change any code, names, signatures, imports, formatting of code lines, or behaviour. Do not create or modify any other file. Work only with the read/search/edit tools; when the docstrings are in place, stop.
instructions.test_generation: In this repository, create a new file {test_file} containing at least three new unittest test methods for {module}, importing it as `import {module}` or `from {module} import ...`. Do not modify any file under inventory/ or any existing test. Work only with the read/search/edit/write tools; when the new tests are written, stop.
